title: Potential conflict with custom shortcut and Shader Editor Control+B
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3.stable.steam [77dcf97d8]



### System information

Godot v4.3.stable (77dcf97d8) - Windows 10.0.26100 - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6109) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 Threads)

### Issue description

So I assigned a Control+B shortcut for the "Run Project" shortcut in Editor Settings (because I wanted it close to Mac default one xD)
And I noticed that if we are on the Shader Editor it doesn't work. At first I thought it was just a minor "not focused" thing, but after assigning a new shortcut (Control+P), that one works. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7c50eaa2-f30a-42ab-8002-f19ae975a756)

So then I noticed that Control+B is Shader Editor "Go to next bookmark" shortcut so that's why it doesn't work.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0abfffb7-2cd0-4401-a0f8-48da9849d9fe)

This is a minor annoyance and easily fixable, but right now there's no way (?) to know when something is conflicting with each other.
This is bound to happen so would be nice to at least know, and then the user could pick.




### Steps to reproduce

1 Go to Editor Settings, and then Shortcuts
2 Find "Run Project"
3 Add a Control+B shortcut and a Control+P shortcut.
4 Go to the Shader Editor and select it
5 Notice that pressing Control+P run the project but Control+B does not
